assetStatus: Already implemented — a hand-built React Three Fiber scene (EarthSpaceViewer.tsx, mode="tides"), not a pending asset. Earth and the Moon render from the same real, already-cleared GLBs used elsewhere in Space.
visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow/bloom. Earth spins at the learner-set speed with a marker point that reads its current tide state (high/low/rising/falling) as it passes through the two fixed bulge axes; the spring/neap toggle changes bulge strength in the readout.
materialNotes: Earth and Moon use their existing real GLB material sets (metallic-roughness PBR); no emissive channels — tide state is read from the spin-angle marker and the side-panel readout, not a rendered water-bulge mesh.
note: Process-driven component: the 'Touch it' interaction is a live physics simulation (spin-speed slider, spring/neap toggle) rather than tapping points on a single model, so this component intentionally carries no hotspots.
